title: Over 100 families lose homes in Cebu fire on All Saints’ Day
summary: More than 100 families lost their homes after a fire razed dozens of houses in Sitio Alaska, Barangay Mambaling, Cebu City on Sunday night, November 1, during the observance of All Saints’ Day.
